text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: How's that, Trainer! My flawless strategy has completely dominated the board!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That's right... Not a single soul
could catch me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Seizing victory through superior strategy—truly, I am the master of the board!
choice_data_list: That was really amazing! Way to go, Ruler!
I'll prove that no game is an exception.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that right!
There's nothing left to do but build a bronze statue someday!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: The achievements of the great ruler of the board should be properly preserved for future generations.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Let's record every single race I've won, too.
It'll be quite a sight to see... just how long the list gets.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, exactly. I must prove that it was neither a fluke
nor just a stroke of good luck."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
My victory is achieved through
my flawless strategy.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Even if opponents change, even if the environment and conditions change...
I will prove it by continuing to win regardless!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, my strategy already takes your presence into account.
I'm expecting great work from you.
